decisions.scope: Future non-authoritative v0.2 Autism Evidence candidate only; the authoritative v0.1 Autism object and its preserved source text remain unchanged.
decisions.accepted_value: Cheung, Phoebe Pui Pui; Lau, Benson Wui Man. Neurobiology of sensory processing in autism spectrum disorder (2020).

decisions.scope: The two Autism v0.1 related_to relation units remain recoverable as legacy-retained-unmapped migration data until a later explicit relation-migration policy or individual semantic review provides a non-fabricating v0.2 representation.
decisions.reopening_condition: Reopen only if a later accepted relation-migration policy can represent the legacy relation without inventing confidence, or if an individual relation is explicitly reviewed as a new semantic act.

decisions.scope: The two Autism v0.1 uncertainty units retain their exact list-valued what_would_reduce_it arrays as legacy-retained-unmapped migration data until a later accepted schema-policy can represent one-or-many reduction conditions directly.
decisions.reopening_condition: Reopen only through an explicit schema-policy decision that preserves one-or-many reduction conditions directly, or another explicitly accepted reversible representation that does not erase item boundaries.

decisions.scope: All four Autism v0.1 ecosystem_entry_points remain exactly recoverable as legacy-retained-unmapped migration data until a first-class ecosystem or navigation model is explicitly designed.
decisions.reopening_condition: Reopen when a first-class ecosystem or navigation model is explicitly designed; embedded questions may be considered individually only through separate review of their independent reusability.

decisions.scope: When structural migration is prepared, Autism and Neurodiversity form the minimum paired non-authoritative candidate required to preserve their reciprocal narrower_than and broader_than relationship under the v0.2 graph contract.
decisions.reopening_condition: The structural dependency may be closed only after a paired non-authoritative Autism and Neurodiversity candidate is prepared and validates the reciprocal v0.2 relation without weakening the reciprocity rule.

decisions.scope: Migrated structural broader_than and narrower_than relations with no legacy confidence must remain without a confidence value until evidence-backed enrichment or a separately accepted structural-confidence schema policy supplies a non-fabricating representation.
decisions.reopening_condition: Reopen the missing-confidence blocker only when an evidence-backed confidence value is proposed for explicit review or a separate structural-confidence schema policy is proposed and accepted.

decisions.scope: Future non-authoritative v0.2 Autism WHO Perspective candidate only.

accepted_fields.held_by.scope: WHO institutional global public-health guidance on autism; not a statement representing all clinicians, autistic people, families, researchers or WHO Member States individually.
accepted_fields.reasoning: WHO frames autism as diverse, with variable and evolving abilities and needs, and links health and quality of life to accessible, inclusive, person-responsive services plus community and societal support.
accepted_fields.scope: Global public-health description of autism, health and care needs, inclusion and support across the life course; excludes individual diagnosis and does not purport to capture the full range of autistic lived experience or community perspectives.
